Autonomous agent that scans Ansible logs, diagnoses routine failures (stale hostname, removed module, undefined var), patches playbooks, commits via conventional commits, and re-runs the pipeline. LLM-first (GLM-4-Plus via z-ai SDK) with a deterministic rule-based fallback.

PancakePulse is an AI agent marketplace on BNB Chain built for solo trading and yield management. It allows users to discover, hire, and deploy autonomous agents to automate PancakeSwap V3 liquidity rebalancing, CAKE yield farming, and smart routing 24/7.

An autonomous agent that reviews every dependency update pull request opened by Renovate, investigates what actually changed, and posts an assessment back on the PR.  Built and running in production at a specialty distribution company. Extracted from a private monorepo to stand on its own.

Personal Context Agent: An autonomous agent that continuously  observes a user's temporal and spatial context, then acts without  prompting to surface missing items before you leave, recall where  things are, and reconstruct your day. Built with Gemini 3.5, Google ADK,  and Cloud Run.

Developed in Python, this project features an autonomous agent using Q-Learning and OpenCV to play Flappy Bird in real-time via Android screen mirroring (scrcpy). It combines computer vision, state discretization, Epsilon Decay, and a finite-state machine for full game-loop automation.

SHADOW is an autonomous agentic AI risk operations center for Razorpay gateways. It replaces rigid static rules with real-time behavioral telemetry and Gemini-driven chain-of-thought reasoning to instantly detect zero-day fraud, eliminate false positives, and generate instant forensic compliance audit logs

CommercePilot is an autonomous agentic commerce platform combining a conversational shopper interface with a merchant revenue control tower. Powered by Gemini, the customer agent handles product discovery and discount negotiations, while the Growth Agent runs A/B experiments. A deterministic policy engine secures margins and budget limits.

RevenueGuard AI  An autonomous agent I built for the AI Revenue Recovery challenge. It detects failed payments, abandoned checkouts, and overdue invoices, diagnoses the root cause, then runs bounded recovery sequences (retries, nudges, escalations) with full audit logs and human handoff for sensitive cases. Python, Flask, LangChain.

An autonomous agent that reads an existing trading strategy backtest, understands it with an LLM, then iteratively improves it — sweeping parameters and proposing structural code changes — until it meets your net PnL, win rate, drawdown, and recovery targets, scoring every run independently from its trade log.

NEXUS 1.0 is a secure, local agentic AI platform. Assign any task and 5 autonomous agents collaborate across 20+ GGUF models to produce superior results. All inference runs entirely on-device with AES-256 encryption and zero data exfiltration. Available for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.

Benchmarking a single LLM call vs a fixed workflow vs an autonomous agent on 38 analytics tasks with known causal ground truth. Both the workflow and the agent refuse 100% of unsupported causal questions, but the workflow grounds 71% of refusals in data, the agent 29%.

Autonomous agent that scans tracked and discovered GitHub repos for open issues, scores each one's fit against a skill profile using Gemini 3.5, and keeps a deduplicated, continuously-updated ranked list. Runs on a schedule via Cloud Run Jobs and Cloud Scheduler, backed by Firestore.

ShipGuard is an autonomous agent that turns TestFlight crash reports and beta-tester feedback into evidence-based, Xcode-validated GitHub pull requests. It investigates the codebase, proposes a minimal fix, validates it on a real macOS runner, and keeps the developer in control of the final merge.

Autonomous AI Revenue Recovery Suite (Razorpay Buildathon): Developed a full-stack autonomous agent using FastAPI and React to recover failed payments via dynamic webhook ingestion. Leveraged Google Gemini LLM to diagnose root causes and negotiate margin-safe discounts while enforcing strict compliance audit trails and (DND) stopping rules.

A locally executed two-agent application built under Google's A2A protocol, using their SDK. A client agent autonomously discovers a remote birthday information agent, sends a natural language query, and receives a date of birth response. This demonstrates autonomous agent discovery and communication as a foundation for multi-agent coordination.

An autonomous, agentic AI microservice architecture that intercepts failed payments at the edge, reasons about root causes using XGBoost and Groq (Llama-3), and executes real-time recovery strategies. Built with Go, Python, React, and Kubernetes to maximize Razorpay merchant GMV with fully explainable, audit-ready AI. Built for the Buildathon.
